scheme_name: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must have orthopaedic disability of 40% or above
Applicant must not be receiving any other financial assistance for conveyance purpose
Applicant must not have any formal education qualification
Applicant must surrender any free bus pass to the Directorate of Social Welfare
Applicant must be a native/resident of Puducherry for at least 5 years
benefits_summary: ₹300 per month transport allowance paid through Anganwadi Centres.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
